author: Josh Ayen
title: Mastodons' win streak snapped in 74-65 loss to Oakland - NewsBreak
text:
By Josh Ayen ,
1 hours ago
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) – In a battle between two of the top three teams in the Horizon League, Purdue Fort Wayne folded in the final minutes in a 74-65 loss to Oakland on Wednesday at the Gates Center.
The loss snaps a five-game winning streak for Purdue Fort Wayne, who falls to third place in the conference standings. Oakland also completes a regular season sweep over the Mastodons, giving the Golden Grizzlies a head-to-head tiebreaker for conference tournament seeding.
Purdue Fort Wayne torched the nets in the opening minutes, hitting six 3-pointers in the first eight minutes of the game. However, the Mastodons also struggled to defend Oakland inside the ark. The Golden Grizzlies took a 40-38 lead to halftime.
The second half was much more of a defensive struggle. Corey Hadnot laid in a bucket to tie the game at 56-56 with 8:12 to go. Oakland closed the game on an 18-9 run, including 12-2 burst after the final media timeout.
Hadnot led the Mastodons with 22 points on 7-of-18 shooting, including 4-of-10 from 3-point range. Max Nelson finished with 15 points, all of those coming on 3-pointers. Deandre Craig Jr. scored 11 to round out the double-digit scorers for Purdue Fort Wayne.
The Mastodons (13-9, 7-4 Horizon League) are back home on Saturday to host Robert Morris at Memorial Coliseum. That game tips off at 1 p.m.
